comments.author: rasmuslund
comments.body: This pattern backtracks catastrophically on long inputs — a 2KB string with no match hangs the worker for seconds. It needs a possessive quantifier or a plain scan; pasted the ReDoS probe input that stalls it.

comments.author: sofiekrug
comments.body: Rewrote as a single linear scan, benchmarked the probe input from 4.2s down to 3ms and added it as a regression case (run 5188, green). No further action on this one.
